rule: Documented as shipped. No tokens: orientation is app configuration, not a design value.
summary: Both apps: phones portrait only, tablets every orientation, no foldable support. The only difference is how the phone lock is set (iOS app delegate, Android from code per screen).

android.how: Locked from code by Utils.disablePhoneLandscape() in MainActivity, articles, settings, gallery, paywall and web view; the manifest sets no orientation

ios.how: Section fronts change layout by window width, not device (bp-front-small / medium / large)

android.how: values-sw500dp loads the tablet config (is_phone=false), but section fronts still render in phone mode (BaseMainActivity.isPhone() returns true)

ios.how: No foldable or iPhone Duo handling

android.how: No androidx.window, WindowSizeClass or fold handling; folding or unfolding recreates MainActivity
